original.statement: The deprecated CLI flag `enable-remote-node-identity` has been removed and is no longer honoured.

decision.reason: [ev-b8b62ef806f0] says, under "Removed Options", that "The deprecated flag `enable-remote-node-identity` has been removed". That supports a cli-flag subject named --enable-remote-node-identity with change type removed. The text does not name a specific component, so leaving the component out is correct. The validators found nothing either way because the chart render was unavailable, so this decision rests on the prose alone.
